Application Data.NAME: CleanCare Linen Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanCare Linen Services specializes in the collection, cleaning, and distribution of diapers and linen for both commercial and residential clients. Our operations include the use of industrial washing machines and dryers to ensure high-quality cleaning standards. We prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant regulations, implementing routine equipment maintenance and proper chemical storage practices. Our facility is equipped with ventilation systems designed to mitigate fire hazards, and we strictly adhere to guidelines for the disposal of wastewater and chemical residues. We strive to maintain a safe working environment for our employees and uphold the highest environmental standards in our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a fire incident occurred due to lint accumulation in the dryer vents, resulting in property damage estimated at $10,000. The incident was reported, and the status is closed. Additionally, on 08/10/2022, a mechanical failure in an industrial washer caused an employee injury, with associated medical costs totaling $5,000. This claim is currently open, awaiting resolution. Total losses reported amount to $15,000.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during operating hours; fencing surrounding facility; regular safety drills conducted for employees.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Businesses using unregulated or banned cleaning agents, including solvents not
compliant with EPA or local environmental regulations.
– Operations with no routine equipment maintenance, increasing the risk of mechan-
ical failure, fire, or employee injury.
– Facilities lacking proper ventilation or chemical storage, or those with a history of
regulatory violations related to environmental discharge or worker safety.
– Businesses that improperly dispose of wastewater or chemical residues in viola-
tion of local environmental laws.
Key Risk Considerations
Underwriters should carefully evaluate the following risk factors,
which are common in diaper and linen service operations:
• Fire hazards arising from overheated dryers, malfunctioning boilers, or electrical faults in
industrial washing machines. For example, lint accumulation in dryer vents can ignite, causing
